algorithm: Compute the binomial coefficient using the formula: \binom{n}{k} = \frac{n!}{k!(n-k)!} for nonnegative integers n and k.
Use efficient algorithms based on prime factorization for performance.
constraints: n must be an integer in 0..50
k must be an integer in -3..55
inputs: n is an integer in 0..50; k is an integer in -3..55.
output: Exact Python int binomial coefficient, including zero when k < 0 or k > n.
